title: Add class names transform like localsConvention in postcss-module
impact: 6 reactions; one commenter offered a PR (2025-04) asking for design pointers, with no maintainer answer. Likely users of Vite with css.transformer='lightningcss', where postcss-modules' localsConvention isn't available (not verified).
code: src/css_modules.rs: CssModule exports (keyed by original name)
summary: Request for camelCase export keys (postcss-modules localsConvention). Lightning CSS doesn't generate the JS module: it returns an `exports` map keyed by the original name, and the integrator (Parcel, Vite, etc.) turns it into JS. Renaming keys is a one-liner on that map, so this arguably belongs in the integrating tool, not core.
repro: 633-repro.mjs (control): `.button-base{} .x_y{}` with cssModules:true -> exports keys ['button-base','x_y'] on master and 1.31.1–1.33.0. The default must stay this way; any convention would be opt-in.
evidence: scripts/repro.mjs on local, 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1. node/index.d.ts has no such option.

fix.approach: If accepted: an opt-in `localsConvention`-like enum on Config (camelCase, camelCaseOnly, dashes, dashesOnly) applied when building `exports`. The 'non-Only' variants would need duplicate keys pointing at one export. Otherwise close: integrators transform the keys of `exports`. Recommend replying to the would-be contributor either way.

notVerified: Whether Vite (lightningcss transformer) or Parcel already apply a key convention themselves; Vite isn't in node_modules here.
